name: seated single leg hugging knee flexion
description: Seated, you hug one knee toward your chest and bend it. It mobilizes the hip and knee gently.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
